> An observatory-themed CAD marble machine for a nominal 8 mm printed marble. A manual selector chooses between a funnel route and an adjustable tipping-cup route, which merge into a guarded three-tray cascade and front collector. Detachable track sections and a fit coupon support assembly and tolerance checks. Current stage: CAD design; physical operation and print fit still need testing.
